newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures settle higher in technical trade.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures settle higher in technical trade.

text.p: FCOJ futures closed higher on light fund buying as prices retraced recent losses, market sources said.
They said Tropical Storm Ana was mildly supportive to the market, which remains entrenched in its recent trading range as the 1996/97 harvest comes to a close.
Support in most-active September remained at 74.05 cents a lb, followed by 72.00 cents. It closed 0.70 higher at 76.60 cents, traded 77.90 to 75.90 cents. The rest finished up 0.55 to 1.05.
An estimated 2,300 lots changed hands on the day, compared with Tuesday's official 2,618 lots.
Total open interest fell by 105 lots but remained high at 31,659 lots as of Tuesday, NYCE said.

Meteorologists said the first tropical storm of the season, which had drifted about 330 miles southeast of Cape Hatteras, North Carolina, is expected to turn away from the United States in the next 24 hours.
